title: DataSubjectRequest
description: PACK-09, ADR-040/ADR-041. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.DataSubjectRequest). A data-subject or other legal request, always attached to its own governed ProceduralCase. It carries NO identity data whatsoever: the requester appears as a per-case party reference, and identity verification is a STATUS plus an opaque reference to the service that performed it - never an attribute, document, eID assertion or KYC payload (PACK-09 required invariant 11). A request is never answered while identity_verification_status is not 'verified'. search_result_references and completion_evidence_reference are references to material held elsewhere, never the material itself. This system provides a governed workflow and auditability; it does not determine legal compliance. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
